trend.summary: Both closed trades this week were losses (SOFI put -$59, ETSY -$16.88) with an 11.5% max drawdown on a tiny account. Equity is still up 5.5% because of open positions, and the losses came from a tight stop on a put and a failed breakout that was cut quickly, which is the strategy working as designed. Two trades is too small a sample to justify a big retune, but false breakouts at a 55-day lookback with a 1.2x volume floor are worth filtering a bit more.

applied.reason: Require stronger volume confirmation to reduce failed breakouts and avoid spending scarce settled cash on marginal setups.
The SOFI put was stopped out on an underlying trail, and more time value cushions option decay and noise on small positions.

The recent notes show the filters (1:1 reward-to-risk floor, sector limits, extension cap) are working as intended and I'm not forcing trades.
